title: Unify literature search routing
description: Removes the hard rejection path in arc_search_literature, adds optional user_query/mode arguments, and keeps the tool usable for both topic literature search and academic metadata enrichment after native web-first lookup.
changes: Remove the wrong_tool_for_specific_paper_lookup rejection path from arc_search_literature.
Add optional user_query and mode arguments so the tool can carry the original request and intent marker.
Reframe arc_search_literature as a unified academic retrieval entry point while leaving native websearch/webfetch as the first step for concrete paper lookup.
Keep lookup_paper disabled in the tool export.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous topic-only guard behavior.
